name: Brock's List
summary: Brock's List carries the names of mining pupils honored by the guild halls in Ironforge. Brock Stoneseeker, the mining instructor in Thelsamar, compiles the dispatch for students who earn honorary picks.

sections.title: A Miner's Distinction
sections.body: In Thelsamar, Brock Stoneseeker records the mining pupils who prove their skill. Apprentices must show what they can do before taking on serious work in Khaz Modan's veins. The honored students earn picks from the guild halls in Ironforge, marks of their skill as miners.

sections.title: The Road to the Great Forge
sections.body: Brock's List travels from Thelsamar to the Deep Mountain Mining Guild in Ironforge's Great Forge. A gryphon carries the dispatch from Thelsamar's roost to Golnir Bouldertoe. There, the students' names are engraved on their honorary picks.

faq.answer: Brock's List is a roster written by Brock Stoneseeker, the mining instructor in Thelsamar. It names apprentices who excel in mining lessons and earn honorary picks.

faq.q: Who do I deliver Brock's List to?
aliases: where do i take the list
faq.answer: Show Brock's List to Thorgrum Borrelson, the gryphon master in Thelsamar, to arrange passage. Then carry it to Golnir Bouldertoe at the Deep Mountain Mining Guild in Ironforge's Great Forge.

faq.q: Why does Golnir Bouldertoe need this document?
aliases: why does ironforge need the list
faq.answer: Golnir Bouldertoe oversees the Deep Mountain Mining Guild's tools in Ironforge. He has honorary picks ready and needs Brock's roster to engrave each student's name on a pick.

faq.q: Why is the list sent by gryphon rather than foot?
faq.answer: The mountain passes through Loch Modan connect to Dun Morogh, but a gryphon from Thorgrum Borrelson's roost carries the list swiftly and safely to the Great Forge.

angles.text: As a prospector, you can see Brock's List honors apprentices who have earned a place in the Deep Mountain Mining Guild's traditions.
As a dwarf, you know the list honors young miners devoted to the pick and shovel beneath Khaz Modan.
